analysis.description: This paper evaluates the performance of modular architectures in machine learning by simulating known modular data distributions. It identifies areas where modular architectures excel and where they fall short, proposing evaluation metrics for specialization and collapse. The work suggests that while modular systems offer benefits, they often do not achieve their potential due to current training methods.
